== Summary ==
The Luke Skywalker ''Return of the Jedi'' lightsaber replica (limited-edition prop replica in a display case) that the playing community gave [[Scott Lingrell]] with his Lifetime Achievement Award, presented by [[Matt Sokol]] at the [[2011 World Championship]] in Washington, D.C. Photographed at Lingrell's home.

* '''Source:''' [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=642800#p642800 Post by Advocate (Scott Lingrell)], "Scott's lifetime achievement award", forum.starwarsccg.org, 2011 World Championships forum (19 August 2011), attachment IMAG0686.jpg: "the one thing that was given to me on top of all of that, was a replica of Luke's Return of the Jedi lightsaber ... I'll be posting an image with this post. Its sitting in my TV Room"
* '''Original image:''' https://forum.starwarsccg.org/download/file.php?id=2586
* '''Image preserved copy:''' [https://web.archive.org/web/20170720052741/http://www.starwarsccg.org/forums/download/file.php?id=2586 Internet Archive]
* '''Date:''' 15 August 2011 (camera date; HTC phone)
* '''Photographer:''' [[Scott Lingrell]]
* '''Identification:''' Lingrell's post.
